violation_type.title: Training Requirements for Directors 30- Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(6)(A))
violation_type.short_title: Training Requirements for Directors 30- Annual Training
violation_type.typical_finding: The Director could not produce 30 hours of required annual training.

finding_variants.text: The Director could not produce 30 hours of required annual training.
Annual training in SIDS, shaken baby syndrome, early childhood brain development, abuse/neglect and transportation was not completed by the director.
The director's 30 clock hours of annual trianing for the previous training year (9/20 - 9/21) was not available for review at the time of the inspection.
The director is missing annual training hours in the following topics:  -Adminstering medication  -Responding to food allergy emergencies  -Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials

The director did not have verification of her required 30 hours of annual training.   Total training hours met = 13, 17 additional hours needed.    There was no verification of the additional 2 hours of required transportation training needed for drivers.
A staff has not completed 30 annual traniing hours from cycle 12/12/21 to 12/11/22. A second staff does not have 24 clock hours from cycle 12/18/21 to 12/17/22.
